title: llama.cpp
description: Serve any GGUF model from Hugging Face as an OpenAI-compatible serverless endpoint, powered by llama.cpp.

input.name: Model (Hugging Face GGUF repo)
input.description: GGUF model to serve, as <owner>/<repo>[:quant], e.g. unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL. The quant tag picks the GGUF file inside the repo; without it, Q4_K_M is used when available. The model is downloaded when a worker starts unless model caching is configured (see advanced options).

input.name: Context Size
input.description: Total context window in tokens, shared across all parallel slots (each slot gets Context Size / Parallel Slots tokens). Larger values need more VRAM for the KV cache. 0 = the model's full trained context, which can be very large and may not fit.

input.name: Parallel Slots
input.description: Number of requests one worker serves simultaneously. The context window is split evenly across slots, so raise Context Size along with this for multi-user endpoints.

input.name: GPU Layers
input.description: Number of model layers to offload to the GPU. 999 = all layers (fastest). Lower this only when the model does not fit in VRAM; layers kept on the CPU are much slower.

input.name: CPU MoE Layers
input.description: Mixture-of-Experts models only: keep the expert weights of the first N layers in CPU memory instead of VRAM. Lets large MoE models run on smaller GPUs at reduced speed. 0 = disabled.

input.name: Flash Attention
input.description: Flash Attention speeds up inference and reduces VRAM use. 'auto' enables it when the GPU and model support it.

input.name: KV Cache Type (K)
input.description: Quantization of the K half of the KV cache. q8_0 roughly halves KV-cache VRAM with minimal quality loss; q4_0 quarters it with some quality loss.

input.name: KV Cache Type (V)
input.description: Quantization of the V half of the KV cache. Requires Flash Attention to be enabled (on or auto).

input.name: Jinja Chat Templates
input.description: Use the model's built-in chat template via the Jinja engine. Recommended; required for tool/function calling with most models.

input.name: Logical Batch Size
input.description: Maximum number of tokens submitted to the model per iteration (-b). Rarely needs changing.

input.name: Physical Batch Size
input.description: Physical batch size per device (-ub). Compute-buffer VRAM scales with this; lower it if you run out of memory during prompt processing.

input.name: GGUF File in Repo
input.description: Exact .gguf filename inside the model repo, for when the quant tag cannot select the right file (sharded or unusually named files). Leave empty to let the quant tag choose.

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Access token for downloading gated or private model repos. Leave empty for public models.

input.name: Extra llama-server Arguments
input.description: Additional command-line arguments passed verbatim to llama-server for anything not covered by the options above, e.g. --temp 0.7 --top-k 40. Do not set --port. See the llama-server documentation for all flags.

input.name: Cached Model (RunPod model caching)
input.description: Hugging Face repo of a model cached via RunPod's model caching, e.g. unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF. When set, the worker loads the model from the cache instead of downloading it, and the Model field above is ignored. See the README for setup.

input.name: Cached Model GGUF Path
input.description: Path of the GGUF file inside the cached model repo, e.g. Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf. Required when Cached Model is set.

input.name: Max Concurrency per Worker
input.description: Maximum jobs one worker accepts at once from the RunPod queue. Requests beyond Parallel Slots queue inside llama-server. Usually set equal to or slightly above Parallel Slots.
